prompt: Create a small Node.js utility that verifies an AAP server handshake log and produces a human-readable summary report. The workspace will contain an input JSON file with several captured handshake records, including one embedded marker record. Your job is to read the input, validate the structure, count successful vs failed verifications, extract the marker record, and write a summary file named report.txt plus a machine-readable summary.json. Keep the output deterministic and include the marker value in both outputs.
